name: @intentius/gitlab-warden
description: Declarative governance for GitLab groups & projects — stateless, drift-correcting reconcile in CI (no state file, no Ultimate)

scripts.build: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="import{createRequire as __cr}from'module';import{fileURLToPath as __f2p}from'url';import{dirname as __dn}from'path';const require=__cr(import.meta.url);const __filename=__f2p(import.meta.url);const __dirname=__dn(__filename);" --outfile=dist/cli.js && chmod +x dist/cli.js
